codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

items.question: When is the Volatiles release date?
items.answer: Not announced. The October 8, 2026 reveal shipped with a trailer and a Steam wishlist link only — no window, no year. Our release date tracker documents how to know the moment that changes.

items.question: Is Volatiles co-op or multiplayer?
items.answer: No. Steam lists it as single-player only, with no announced multiplayer or co-op mode. The lab-nightmare narrative and the tile-choice economy are built for one player.

items.question: Who is making Volatiles?
items.answer: Team Instant Defeat, a newly established studio, with 11 bit studios as publisher. 11 bit is known for Frostpunk and This War of Mine and for publishing roguelikes like Children of Morta and Moonlighter.

items.question: What platforms will Volatiles be on?
items.answer: PC via Steam, with full controller support including DualSense and DualShock. No console versions have been announced.

items.question: What makes Volatiles different from other roguelikes?
items.answer: You build the battlefield itself: each round you select one of three tiles, and tiles carry defensive structures, loot, and modifiers — including ones that make hordes spawn 100% more often on purpose.
